info.name: SortPi API - full test
info.description: Login, every GET list/report, full create/read/PATCH/PUT/DELETE flow with a sale, return, idempotent replay, and negative checks. Records are named ZZ-API-TEST. Set email and password in the environment; run folders in order.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.environment.get('email'), password: pm.environment.get('password') }) } }, (err, res) => {
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('login failed', err || res.code); return; }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { try { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("accessToken", j.data.access); } catch (e) {} }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { try { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("refreshToken", j.data.refresh); } catch (e) {} }

if (pm.response.code < 300) { try { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("branchId", (j.data.active_branch && (j.data.active_branch.id || j.data.active_branch)) || (j.data.branches && (j.data.branches[0].id || j.data.branches[0]))); } catch (e) {} }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { try { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("warehouseId", j.data[0].id); } catch (e) {} }
